title: Komorebi Temple — The Autumn Sutra
description: A Japanese Buddhist precinct with swept charcoal roofs: an open worship hall and projecting ceremonial entrance, a three-storey pagoda crowned by a nine-ring sorin, a golden altar, stone lanterns and an autumn maple. Fitted foundations are joined by a short ascending passage.
